note: Mistvale action table for the DV2-format pack. Motion structure (slot count/af, pose per slot, weapon direction/inv/show, draw order, effect slots, head expression, loop) is derived from the DV2 kit by tools/dv2-motion-derive.mjs; grips (wh/oh) and neck points (head) are measured on OUR art (apply_actions_class.py + fists.json). Units: 1x DV2 px, foot = (0,0). views[view][slot] = cell/head/wh/oh (+ fx for our own effects, mirrored per direction); dirs[dir] = screen-space weapon sebF/deg/inv/show, effect, draw order (not mirrored again).
